ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.title: Shifty Shop
ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.pages.INITIAL.desc:
You come across a strange shop.
The merchant in front of you holds something in one hand while [sine][gold]referencing and imitating[/gold][/sine] with the other.
You don't want to leave empty-handed—perhaps you could [red][sine]sneakily[/sine][/red] take a few things.
ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.pages.INITIAL.opti: Fight the fake merchant for [gold]better rewards[/gold].
ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.pages.TAKERELICS.d:
You only wanted a small bargain, grabbing a few relics before hurrying away.
Then the fake merchant turns around.
[sine][red]Stop, you thief![/red][/sine]
You leave without looking back, pretending nothing happened.
ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.pages.TAKERGOLDS.d:
You only wanted a small bargain, grabbing a coin purse before hurrying away.
Then the fake merchant turns around.
[sine][red]Stop, you thief![/red][/sine]
You leave without looking back, pretending nothing happened.
ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.pages.BEGINFIGHT.d:
You interrupt him—it turns out he was counterfeiting relics!
[red][sine]Oh, what are you doing! You shouldn't know this.[/sine][/red]
ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.pages.TAKETRUERELI:
You drive the fake merchant away; even the genuine relics he used as reference are left behind.
Now they have a new owner.
BACKROOMS.title: Stumble
BACKROOMS.pages.INITIAL.description:
While walking a rugged stone path, your foot catches on a rock.
[jitter]Ugh! Oh![/jitter]
When you wake again, you are lying in an endless indoor space.
BACKROOMS.pages.INITIAL.options.SEARCH_E: Lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP. [blue]{SearchChance}%[/blue] chance to find the exit.
BACKROOMS.pages.SEARCH_FAIL.description:
You walk in different directions for a long time, but the surroundings look exactly the same.
[sine][red]All you feel is this space slowly eroding your body and mind.[/red][/sine]
BACKROOMS.pages.SEARCH_FAIL.options.SEAR: Lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP. [blue]{SearchChance}%[/blue] chance to find the exit.
BACKROOMS.pages.EXIT.description:
After searching for ages, you finally find a pale-white opening.
You can feel the exit ahead.
You imagine what lies beyond...
BACKROOMS.pages.EXIT.options.LEAVE.title: Jump right in!
BACKROOMS.pages.ENCHANT_DISSOLVE.descrip:
You hesitate, then jump in!
The surroundings grow more familiar; you return to where you started, but a strange gray unfamiliarity clings to the place.
BACKROOMS.pages.TAKE_ALMOND_WATER.descri:
You muster your courage and jump!
The surroundings grow more familiar; you return to where you started, clutching a bottle of clear water in your hand.
BACKROOMS.pages.REST.description:
You lie down where you are. If only it were all a dream...
When you open your eyes again, you find yourself back where you started. Your body feels as though it had a good sleep, yet your mind warns you that something has been lost.
BACKROOMS.pages.LEAVE.description:
Without hesitation, you jump right in!
The surroundings grow more familiar; you return to where you started.
MEDUSA.title: Medusa
MEDUSA.pages.INITIAL.description:
You enter a gloomy area surrounded by countless statues.
At the center, a woman awaits her guests.
[gold][sine]Well hello. How long has it been since we last met?[/sine][/gold]
[gold][sine]Come, tell me what you need.[/sine][/gold]
Lose [gold]{Gold}[/gold] Gold. Choose 1 card from your deck and enchant it with [blue]Retain[/blue].
MEDUSA.pages.INITIAL.options.OFFER_GOLD_: Lose [gold]{Gold}[/gold] Gold. Choose 1 card from your deck and enchant it with [blue]Retain[/blue].
MEDUSA.pages.INITIAL.options.GREET.title: Polite greeting
MEDUSA.pages.RETURN_TO_OWNER.description: You return the Petrified Toad to Medusa. In return, she gifts you a strand of her hair.
MEDUSA.pages.OFFER_GOLD.description: You offer Medusa {Gold} Gold. She touches one of your cards with her fingertip, enchanting it with Retain.
MEDUSA.pages.GREET.description: You greet Medusa politely. She seems surprised and casually hands you a stone shaped like a potion.
